neighbours.label: A program or machine being made aware of, or failing to understand, something: fires on the ' of' after 'aware' and on ' understand' when the knower is software (svn, a bot, the system), at the point where what it knows is about to be named. A person 'conscious of' or 'realizing' something stays quiet.
fire: After copying the folder you must make git aware of the new files.
The parser does not understand what the nested brackets mean.
Run the scan again so the indexer is aware of the renamed tables.
Older browsers do not understand what this tag is for.
You have to make the build tool aware of the extra include path.
The chatbot did not understand what the caller was asking for.
Restart the daemon to make it aware of the changed settings.
The compiler cannot understand what type the function returns.
quiet: After copying the folder you must add the new files to git.
The parser stops at the first nested bracket it reads.
Run the scan again so the indexer covers the renamed tables.
Older browsers simply skip this tag and show nothing.
You have to give the build tool the extra include path.
The chatbot put the caller through to a human agent.
Restart the daemon after you change the settings.
The compiler prints the type that the function returns.

notes: Probe: 'make the system aware of the new files' 1.05, 'The bot did not understand what' 0.70, a dotted import path 0.47; human 'conscious of the risk' 0.03, 'realized that' 0.01, 'inform the staff of' 0.13. Weak pole (max 6.1); the card's top examples are mixed (' that', ' to', ' present', ' cost'), so this covers one facet.
